title: Harry Potter — The boy who lived
source: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001)

hook.context: O'n bir yoshli Harryning tug'ilgan kunida ulkan Hagrid eshikni buzib kiradi va unga hayotini o'zgartiradigan gapni aytadi. Harry umr bo'yi oddiy bola deb o'ylagan edi.

reading: Harry Potter has lived with his aunt, uncle and cousin since he was a baby. They have never loved him. For years he has slept in a small cupboard under the stairs.

On his eleventh birthday a giant called Hagrid arrives and tells Harry the truth: his parents were a witch and a wizard, and Harry is a wizard too. He has already become famous in the magic world, but he has never heard of it.

Harry goes to Hogwarts, a school of magic in an old castle. On the train he meets Ron, and they become friends at once. Later they also make friends with Hermione, a clever girl who has read every book.
At school Harry learns to fly on a broomstick and plays a sport called Quidditch. He discovers that he has a natural talent for it.
Soon the three friends notice that something strange is happening. Somebody wants to steal the Philosopher's Stone, a magic object that can give eternal life.
They have to pass several dangerous tests to protect the stone. Each friend uses a different skill: Ron plays chess, Hermione solves a puzzle, and Harry shows courage.
By the end of the year Harry has found a real home and real friends for the first time in his life.

grammar.title: Present Perfect va Past Simple
explain: **Present Perfect** (have/has + V3) — o'tmish hozirga bog'langan, aniq vaqt aytilmaydi: Harry **has lived** with them since he was a baby (hali ham yashaydi).
**Past Simple** — tugagan, aniq vaqtli o'tmish: His parents **were** a witch and a wizard. On his birthday Hagrid **arrived**.
Present Perfect so'zlari: **ever, never, already, yet, just, for, since**. Past Simple so'zlari: **yesterday, ago, last year, in 2001, when...**
**for** — davomiylik (for years, for ten minutes); **since** — boshlanish nuqtasi (since 2010, since he was a baby). "I have lived here since five years" — xato: **for** five years.

exercises.q: Harry ___ with the Dursleys since he was a baby.
exercises.why: since + hozirgacha davom etmoqda → Present Perfect.

exercises.q: Hermione ___ every book in the library.
exercises.why: Natija hozir muhim, vaqt yo'q: has read (read – read – read).

exercises.q: Have you ___ been to a castle?
exercises.why: Hayotiy tajriba savoli: Have you ever...?
Inkor va savolda gap oxirida: yet.

exercises.q: Ron has been Harry's friend ___ three years.

exercises.why: has just + V3: leave – left – left.
When bilan aniq vaqt so'raladi → Past Simple: When did...?
